named_blocker: PANYNJ authoritative clarification, erratum, or superseding PA-10 text resolving Subrule 34-1140(c), checked as of 2026-07-16
statement: Not determinable. Every serious candidate pair in the fully investigated scope resolves to a non-contradiction disposition except the pairs that turn on PA-10 Subrule 34-1140(c). Clause (c) read literally denies terminal access to every non-alternative-fuel drayage truck (since 2023-07-02), while PANYNJ's own registration pathway (34-1101), sticker schedule (34-1120), operational program statements, and APM's live diesel appointment operations treat compliant MY2014+ diesels as admissible and alternative-fuel trucks as an exemption category. Whether clause (c) is a drafting artifact of the 2010 phase schedule (present unchanged since at least June 2019 with deadlines that repeatedly passed without diesel exclusion) or an operative prohibition contradicted by the agency's own operational framework cannot be resolved without: PANYNJ authoritative clarification, erratum, or superseding PA-10 text resolving Subrule 34-1140(c), checked as of 2026-07-16. If PANYNJ affirmed the literal reading, the 34-1140(c)-vs-operational-framework pair would satisfy all four contradiction conditions at the gate; if PANYNJ confirmed a drafting error, every remaining pair classifies as non-contradictory and the corridor result would be 'no contradiction within scope'.
